Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object

Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: every wrong submission costs 1 and every demo request costs 1. An
instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt cap is reached, and
reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

3. Submit only grids that your program produced.

def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]
    from collections import Counter
    counts=Counter(v for row in g for v in row if v not in (bg,0))
    marker=max(counts, key=counts.get)
    anchors=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==marker]
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (bg,marker,0)]
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
    # Expand the template bbox to include adjacent zeros, which may be
    # foreground stencil cells (as in the demo's 0-0-1-0-0 pattern).
    while c0>0 and any(g[r][c0-1]==0 for r in range(r0,r1+1)): c0-=1
    while c1+1<w and any(g[r][c1+1]==0 for r in range(r0,r1+1)): c1+=1
    while r0>0 and any(g[r0-1][c]==0 for c in range(c0,c1+1)): r0-=1
    while r1+1<h and any(g[r1+1][c]==0 for c in range(c0,c1+1)): r1+=1
    pat=[row[c0:c1+1] for row in g[r0:r1+1]]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r,c in anchors:
        for i in range(len(pat)):
            for j in range(len(pat[0])):
                v=pat[i][j]; rr=r+i-len(pat)//2; cc=c+j-len(pat[0])//2
                if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and v!=bg: out[rr][cc]=v
    return out
